name: Entity System
description: Schema-driven entity definitions, CRUD store, connector abstraction

knowledge.purpose: Schema-first entity layer that defines collection shapes and exposes typed CRUD against a connector
useCases: Declare an app collection like Customer, Product, Order
Validate incoming records against a Zod schema before save
Plug a different storage backend (postgres, in-memory, external API) without changing call sites
Render a list/detail surface bound to an entity collection
antiPatterns: Storing transient UI state as an entity — keep it in form/local state until submit
Embedding business workflow inside entity schemas — use platform/interaction rules
Joins across apps — entities are isolated per app by contract
Registering an external, read-only REST source (e.g. a vendor's list API) as an EntityDefinition — it doesn't live in the host's own store; use a connector + platform/persistence instead

fields.label: Enable Event Bridge
fields.description: Emit entity events to the platform event bridge
